title: Shamir shares form a sharing
statement: Let $F$ be a field, let $k>0$, let $\mathrm{sec}\in F$, and let $q$ be a polynomial of degree less than $k-1$. In the Shamir scheme over $F$ with parameter $k$, the shares produced from $\mathrm{sec}$ and $q$ constitute a sharing of $\mathrm{sec}$ with degree bound less than $k$.
